description: This file defines an enum CLIInstaller responsible for managing the installation and detection of the 'openclaw' CLI tool on macOS. It provides functions to locate the installed CLI, check installation status, perform installation via a shell script, and parse related events.

methods.name: installedLocation
methods.description: Returns the file path of the installed 'openclaw' CLI if present.

methods.name: isInstalled
methods.description: Checks if the 'openclaw' CLI is installed by verifying the installedLocation.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Performs installation of the 'openclaw' CLI, providing status updates via the callback.
